description: LDW surface drawn (simplest drivable state). DI_AEC_LDW_Show gate (diAEControl.cpp) turns sta_ldwStatus=RET_SHOW when the LDW-warning condition is met; the drawing surface requires the master switch on and the inverse-vehicle-condition gate open (gear!=1 -> sta_vehicleConditionShow=RET_SHOW_NOT). One lane-departure warning signal driven active so the warning texture renders. master can frame 0x4C1 asserted.

can.desc: gear!=1 so sta_vehicleConditionShow=RET_SHOW_NOT, opening the LDW show gate

mem.desc: LDW warning active, drives the LDW staus getter
